purpose: Separate real standalone probe cost, fixed common-configuration transfer and episode regrouping from shared-diagnostic mechanism scores.
vocabulary: Keep each dataset's current extension/category protocol unchanged in every condition.
subset_scope: A new fixed subset/composition of historically development-exposed evaluation images, not fresh independent labels or a new population.
timing: Each arm actually computes only its required0/1/2 views. Synchronized full adaptation plus final prediction, excluding setup/loading/scoring and first complete warmup episode. Warmup predictions remain in accuracy; counts and timing images reported separately.
scoring: All requested arms' predictions sealed before opening label pixels; pooled intersections/unions,224x224 nearest-neighbor labels. No metric/aggregator/threshold selection from new scores.
execution_gate: No GPU until worker review, CPU tests, small GT-free schedule/reset/equivalence smoke, explicit source+image+config+ordered-panel manifest and checksums. One worker under shared GPU lock, bounded systemd memory, no retry/overwrite.
acceptance: Report every arm, condition and sign. Do not require min to win; a tie or loss is an informative result. Do not change the rule, subset or configs after observing scores.
